item.text:
Added an explicit result model so the API no longer collapses every search into a raw `List<Integer>`. [KmpMatchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpMatchResult.java:1) now represents one search outcome with `matchIndices()`, `count()`, `hasMatches()`, `firstMatch()`, and `lastMatch()`. That gives callers a stable, higher-level contract and avoids recomputing or re-deriving basic facts from a list.

[KmpPattern.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpPattern.java:10) now exposes `analyzeIn(...)`, and [KmpSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearch.java:5) mirrors it with `analyze(...)`. The demo in [KmpSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchDemo.java:1) was updated to use the result object directly, and [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:4) now verifies the new result behavior alongside the existing search APIs.

Verified with `javac KmpMatchResult.java KmpPattern.java KmpSearch.java KmpSearchDemo.java KmpSearchSelfTest.java`, `java KmpSearchSelfTest`, `java KmpSearchDemo`, and `java KmpSearchDemo xyz a`.
